# Glushkov Modelling
> A personal archive of wooden sailing ship models from the 18th–19th centuries, with detailed build logs, workshop tutorials, and notes by Andrey Glushkov.

## About
Andrey Glushkov is a master model builder based in Russia, specialising in scale wooden ship models (1:48–1:60). The site documents completed and ongoing builds, techniques, and historical context.

## Key pages

- /builds — catalogue of all ship models
- /builds/le-requin — full build log for Le Requin 1750 (French xebec, scale 1:48, admiralty style)
- /builds/bounty — full build log for HMAV Bounty (1:60, Amati kit)
- /tutorials — step-by-step workshops on rigging, planking, finishing, and painting
- /gallery — photo archive of completed models
- /about — about the builder
